messages:
alex.k: Hi folks — I'm Alex (new infra-dev). Onboarding ask: I need to run e2e on a GKE cluster that writes billing export tables to BigQuery in the 'billing-exports' dataset, and our CI needs to push AMIs/artifacts into the shared infra AWS account. Who should I ask for the right roles and what's the minimal set of permissions? cc @cloud-ops
mel: welcome! :wave: For GCP first, we usually create a dedicated service account in your sandbox project and grant it BigQuery Data Editor (or a custom writer role) on the billing dataset. Then give your user 'Service Account Token Creator' on that SA so pods can impersonate it.
shawn: ^^ also for GKE -> Workload Identity you need the SA and a k8s service account mapped to it. File a cloud-access ticket with project id, dataset name, and the k8s namespace/ksa name. Tag @oncall-cloud if urgent.
infra-bot: Reminder: use the cloud-access template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD (select 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions') Please include AWS account id, project id, datasets, and intended expiration.
lina: For AWS cross-account, we'll ask infra to create an assume-role in the shared account. You'll need the role ARN and then add an inline policy to your user allowing sts:AssumeRole for that ARN. Example role name convention: redwood-infra-onboard-<your-name>.
mel: Quick concrete GCP commands you can paste in ticket if infra wants to pre-provision: ```bash
# grant SA token creator to your user
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding billing-pipeline-sa@your-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member="user:alex.k@redwood.com" --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
# grant SA access to dataset
bq add-iam-policy-binding billing-exports.dataset 
  --member=serviceAccount:billing-pipeline-sa@your-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com 
  --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
```
alex.k: thanks — is there a standard expiry for onboarding perms? I prefer temp access to reduce blast radius.
mel: we default to 30 days for onboarding. Put desired expiry in the ticket and infra will set an IAM condition or create time-limited AWS creds. If you need longer, request extension before expiry.
shawn: FYI for workload identity binding you also need to add: ```bash
# allow KSA to impersonate SA
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding billing-pipeline-sa@your-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/PROJECT_NUMBER/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/POOL_ID/attribute.repository/namespace:your-namespace" \
  --role="roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
```
lina: If you want me to pre-fill the ticket, drop the project id, k8s namespace, ksa name, and AWS account id here and I'll create the request.
alex.k: Filed ticket CLOUD-1427 with project=alex-sbx, dataset=billing-exports, k8s ns=ci-run, ksa=ci-billing-sa, aws acct=987654321000. Marked expiry 30d. Thanks everyone! :grin:
